frontmatter.name: reviewer-high
frontmatter.description: Read-only reviewer for a CODE or SECURITY pass over a diff, at high effort. Use for large changes, refactors, or any change touching money, auth or user data.

frontmatter.name: reviewer-medium
frontmatter.description: Read-only reviewer for a CODE or SECURITY pass over a diff, at medium effort. Use for ordinary changes, one-liners and renames.

frontmatter.name: reviewer-xhigh
frontmatter.description: Read-only reviewer for a CODE or SECURITY pass over a diff, at xhigh effort. Use for large changes that also touch money, auth or user data.

frontmatter.name: fable-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Final reviewer. Use once, after a plan is fully implemented, to review the whole branch before finishing.
